data.name: Spurn Harm
data.description: A sorrowsoul can funnel his bardic powers to persevere in the face of seemingly certain death. A sorrowsoul can spend 3 rounds of his daily bardic performance as an immediate action to gain a +2 insight bonus on all saving throws for 1 round.
